{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for sentinel values in biomarker_baseline
# -999.0 appears in the data — likely a missing value indicator
sentinel_check = trial_df[trial_df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999.0]

# Check if this is only in one arm or both
sentinel_by_arm = sentinel_check['arm'].value_counts()

# Check distribution of severity and sex across arms
severity_by_arm = pd.crosstab(trial_df['arm'], trial_df['severity'])
sex_by_arm = pd.crosstab(trial_df['arm'], trial_df['sex'])

# Print results
print(f'Sentinel value (-999.0) found in {len(sentinel_check)} rows:\n{sentinel_check.head()}\n')
print(f'Sentinel value by arm:\n{sentinel_by_arm}\n')
print(f'Severity distribution by arm:\n{severity_by_arm}\n')
print(f'Sex distribution by arm:\n{sex_by_arm}\n')"}
